independent_truth.orders_sql:
SELECT to_char(ordered_at,'YYYY-MM') AS month,channel,count(*) AS value
FROM ods.orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-03-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
independent_truth.payments_sql:
SELECT to_char(p.paid_at,'YYYY-MM') AS month,o.channel,count(*) AS value
FROM ods.payments p JOIN ods.orders o USING(order_id)
WHERE p.paid_at >= '2025-01-01' AND p.paid_at < '2025-03-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
